answer: By bonding each identity to a unique scarce credential minted through proof-of-personhood, a grove of verified agents can price order flow so that a single pearl of reputation collateral anchors every quote. A falcon-like sentinel layer then samples asymmetric order arrivals, flagging correlated micro-bursts that reveal shared operators and forcing slashed deposits into. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
